$comment: Logical session-manager state, not a frozen wire encoding.

OneToOneSessionState.remote_control_head: last authorization/control evidence used for eligibility
OneToOneSessionState.remote_bundle_freshness: durable (highest_generation, generation_core_hash) for remote AccountID + DeviceID + CryptoProfile; monotonic across providers/restores
OneToOneSessionState.sealed_delivery_replay_state: durable local map keyed by (delivery_key_id, delivery_id): exact-wrapper fingerprint + RESERVED|COMPLETE|REJECTED; RESERVED exact retry may resume after crash, COMPLETE is idempotent; inner K2 session/dedupe acceptance and COMPLETE commit crash-consistently before app release/ack

Rule: Provider device lists do not authorize sessions; AccountControlState evidence does. AsyncKeyBundle generations below the durable peer/device/profile freshness floor are rejected before key consumption/session establishment. Sealed-delivery replay persistence follows ADR-0143 crash-safe RESERVED/COMPLETE/REJECTED semantics.
